title: Rice–Maize GPP Conditional Pooling Analysis Code
description:
Version 1.0.0 of the H2 software for regenerating the reported tables and figures from archived aggregate results in a retrospective comparison of daily gross primary productivity models for Korean rice and US maize.

The original analysis panel comprised 4,357 unique site-days during 2012–2020, including 1,912 rice and 2,445 maize site-days. The fixed comparison used crop-specific fitting (S), unconditioned pooling (P), and crop-conditioned pooling (C), with Ridge regression and random forests under spatial-cluster and year holdout. The prespecified primary contrast was Ridge C−S under spatial-cluster holdout. Secondary comparisons and post hoc site-season adverse-error summaries retain their respective roles in the released outputs.

The explicit verify and reproduce commands read the companion aggregate JSON inputs and produce Tables 1–3, Supplementary Table S1, Figures 1–2, captions, and a separate aggregate-regeneration receipt. The software uses portable input/output paths and records the rendering environment and output checksums. Regeneration requires no new model fitting, prediction or saved-model replay.

The software code is licensed under MIT. Bundled author-generated aggregate material and generated tables/figures are covered by the CC BY 4.0 scope in DATA_LICENSES.md. Dependencies retain their own terms. The companion aggregate-data record provides the matching archived result inputs and outputs. The frozen source-data panel, row-level memberships and OOF predictions, saved estimators and provider-native products remain part of the separately documented analysis archive.

The observations were previously examined, and crop is confounded with country, climate, management and reference-processing history. Calendar-proxy and footprint uncertainty and the single random-forest seed limit interpretation. The release documents a conditional predictive comparison against retained references.

This work was supported by Chonnam National University (Grant No. 2026-1417-01) and the Basic Science Research Program through the National Research Foundation of Korea (Grant No. NRF-2021R1A2C2004459). Neither funder was involved in study design, data collection, analysis or interpretation, manuscript preparation, or the decision to submit. The author declares no competing interests.

The code and data DOIs were reserved for version 1.0.0. This package snapshot was prepared before publication confirmation (RESERVED_PENDING_PUBLICATION; published=false). The intended publication date is 2026-11-07; the actual publication date remains unconfirmed in this snapshot. Software DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24029095. Aggregate-data DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24029126. Source repository: https://github.com/jonghanko/rice-maize-gpp-conditional-pooling.
